question: What is the meaning of recyclability in relation to recovery?
description: Recyclability in relation to recovery refers to the capability of materials or products to be processed and reused in a way that retains their value or functionality. This involves the ability to separate and recover different materials or substances during dismantling or recycling procedures, ensuring that they can be transformed into new products or materials without losing their quality or properties.
